subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (Redwood + Acme Commerce)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Morris <jmorris@acmecommerce.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap & ask: org chart + procurement/security contacts

Hi Jared / Priya —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for taking the time to walk through Acme's priorities for a model inference platform. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the evaluation forward: 

What we heard
- Latency and cost are the top constraints for your search/chat microservices (100–200ms p95 target).
- Security + procurement gate is the likely blocker for any vendor beyond your approved list.
- You're evaluating both hosted and VPC/private options.

Action items we need from Acme
1) High-level stakeholder map (who owns purchase decision, who owns security/compliance review, and who will be technical owner). A simple org chart or bullet list is perfect.
2) Procurement next steps: any PO process, required vendor questionnaires (you mentioned a vendor security questionnaire), and timeline expectations.
3) Intro to the economic buyer (CFO/Head of Product) and the security reviewer if possible — we'd like to align on cost modeling and a security deep-dive.

Proposed next steps from our side
- Rishi (cc'd) will schedule a 30-minute follow-up to demo the latency/cost tradeoffs and to validate the SLOs.
- Neha (cc'd) will coordinate a security questionnaire + evidence items (SOC2 scope, data retention, network isolation).

If you can share the org chart and procurement flow, we can draft a short mutual action plan tied to the timeline you gave (decision target: end of Q3).

Thanks — I can take any draft attachments and forward them to our security team for a quick read.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-sales-deck.pdf]

From: Jared Morris <jmorris@acmecommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmecommerce.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: org chart + procurement/security contacts

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches how we saw the call. Quick answers below and attaching a first-pass org chart.

Attached
- acme-org-chart.pdf (high-level org chart)
- procurement-process.png (procurement intake & typical SLAs)

Stakeholders
- Economic buyer: Alex Chen (CFO) — alex.chen@acmecommerce.com
- Security/compliance reviewer: Priya Sharma (cc'd) — priya.sharma@acmecommerce.com
- Procurement contact: Tom Lee (tom.lee@acmecommerce.com) — usually coordinates contracts/POs

Timeline & notes
- We're targeting a vendor decision by end of Q3; initial POC in July if the security checks are straightforward.
- We have a standard vendor security questionnaire (I can send — we typically expect SOC2 + network architecture diagram and a data flow).

I'll ask Tom to forward any formal procurement docs; for now the two attachments should help. Happy to introduce Alex if you want to loop him into a short call.

Regards,
Jared
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Commerce
[Attachments: acme-org-chart.pdf, procurement-process.png]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Morris <jmorris@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: org chart + procurement/security contacts

Perfect — thanks Jared, that is super helpful. 

Rishi / Neha: looping you both in — see Jared's attachments for the initial org/process mapping. Suggested mutual action plan below; I'll finalize once we have Alex or Tom on board.

Mutual action plan (draft)
- Week 1: Security intake & questionnaire (Neha to lead) — get SOC2 scope, network diagram, data flow.
- Week 2: Technical deep-dive + perf baseline (Rishi to demo with sample workloads).
- Week 3: Commercial proposal (Marissa) + procurement review.

Immediate asks for Acme
- Intro to Alex Chen (CFO) for budget alignment — 15 min expectation-setting call.
- Any vendor questionnaire or required contract redlines from Tom (procurement) we should expect.

I'll propose a few time slots for a 30-min follow-up (Rishi will pick from these or you can use his calendly link below):
- Tue 6/15 10:00–10:30 ET
- Wed 6/16 14:00–14:30 ET

Calendly: https://calendly.com/rishi-redwood/30min

Thanks again, Jared — once we have Alex and Tom in the loop we can lock in the timeline and scope.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx]

- Tue 6/15 10:00–10:30

Rishi Malhotra
